prompts.animals-hunt-food:
Look first: days_of_food, wild_game, hostiles_on_map.
1) game_set cmd hunt -- read the count.  2) count 0: Orders/Hunt designator by hand on each safe animal cell.
3) still 0: ladder_set mark hunt_tried true, then false (3 of those hand over to the fallback).
4) no butcher table yet (mark_butcher_built): survival:butcher-table first.  5) add_bill CookMealSimple count MEAL_BILL_TARGET.
Never NEVER_HUNT, never packs/predators, never during a raid.
Done: designations_hunt > 0, then days_of_food back above FOOD_MIN_DAYS (resets the count).
Owner: "you have no food!! emergency no frefrisgeration hunt make food bills come one your perople WILL DIE!" / "cook bill maintained at 50 rather than 10"
prompts.animals-hunt-fallback:
Hunting failed 3 times (mark hunt_tried counted). Say it on stream, then gather.
1) Orders/Harvest on every berry bush.  2) no field: game_set cmd crops plant Plant_Rice; check fields are harvesting.
3) last resort: Orders/Slaughter the least useful animal, never a mount or milk animal.
Nothing worked: ladder_set mark hunt_tried true, then false.
Done: days_of_food >= FOOD_MIN_DAYS (the counter resets). No done-mark: standing rung.
Owner: "IS AUTO HARVETS NOT WORKING? CROPS NEED HARVET" / "collecting resources planting crops and setting bills for food"
prompts.animals-danger-clear:
Look first: where the dangerous animal is vs your pawns.
1) set_area every colonist to Home.  2) it charges: game_set_draft the shooters, kill it at range.
3) someone downed: field tend first (order_pawn tend), then haul to a bed.
Never hunt or tame it.
Done: danger_animals_near 0 or it is dead. No done-mark: standing alarm.
Owner: "never letting someone melle person or animal get close to your pawns kill them with range at all costs" / "remmebr always field tnde directly brefopre cpature and haul"
prompts.animals-food-steady:
Look first: game_state days_of_food, meals, raw_food.
Fires only after days_of_food >= FOOD_COMFORT_DAYS and meals > 0 held for a full game day (ton 24h).
Tool: ladder_set mark animals_food_steady_done true. Nothing else.
Fallback: food dropped meanwhile -- do nothing, the timer restarts.
Done: mark animals_food_steady_done = true. Until then: no pens, no taming, no mounts.
Owner: "let your people get good on food and set up camp before moving into the base like u said itll tak a while"
prompts.animals-handler:
Look first: game_list_colonists Animals skill. 1) pawn_priorities {Handling:2} 2) everyone else Handling 3, never blank. Refused: game_set cmd set_work_priority pawn

work Handling level 2. Then: ladder_set mark mounts_trained 0 (starts the mount count). Done: ladder_set mark animals_handler_done true. Owner: "you only put 2s on the teask u want each colonist doing spliting theri work up"
prompts.tame-mounts:
Look first: mount_candidates on the map; danger_animals_near must be 0.

Refused / designations_tame still 0: ladder_set mark tame_tried true, then false.
3 refusals: stop taming, buy mounts from a trader.
Done: designations_tame > 0, then mark mounts_trained reaches MOUNT_TARGET (train-mounts).
Owner: "from elephant riding armies drop poding down from your megaship"
prompts.animal-pen:

4) ladder_set mark milk_herd false (starts the milk herd rung).

Done: ladder_set mark animal_pen_done true.
